query:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT violator_id) AS violator_count
FROM (
  SELECT violator_id
  FROM estishraf_llm_traffic_violation
  WHERE gdate_paid IS NULL
    AND gdate_happened <= '2025-07-31'
    AND status_description != 'Cancelled due to the violator''s death'
  GROUP BY violator_id
  HAVING SUM(actual_fine) > 500000
) AS high_fine_violators
LIMIT 100
